keyPhrases.text: What is charming on film evaporates when director Robert Jess Roth transfers it to the stage
Characters that are funny as cartoons turn grotesque when played by actors
You don't care whether they get together or not

reasoning: Review is overwhelmingly negative, describing the show as 'disappointing,' 'emotionally barren,' and 'musically undernourished.' While praising technical elements like sets and costumes, critic harshly criticizes the direction, performances, and emotional core. The damning final line 'You don't care whether they get together or not' seals this as a pan.
